book-bedazzling.name: book-bedazzling
notes: Original representative closed casebound book140x200mm,26mm including boards. Boards,textblock and left spine join; lower board rests on ground. Dimensions approximate familiar objects,not a provided class kit.

Faceted flat-back rhinestones have bases directly seated on the top cover. Thin adhesive layer is implicit. Sixteen large generic decorative stones make an original border/rosette; no copyrighted book design,title or technique instruction.
LOC binding text informed cover/textblock/spine relationships; Beacon manufacturer text informed flat-back rhinestone attachment. No external image or diagram traced.
